notes: PaperThin edge NPZ from Edge V5-V6: velw = peak amplitude of the strongest partial within +-0.25 % of each mode, ^0.8; band envelopes in the plugin's 22 one-third-octave bands, 20 ms frames from the strike, the SPEAR band levels (loudest band = 1); the preset's edge_rms_correction divides each band by its velw norm so each band follows the SPEAR level; smoothed (30 ms) after 200 ms; extended past each capture by its late decay. ONSET TRANSPLANT: the upper rows build up per band as Bettis's edge does (onset_transplant.py); each band keeps its level and decay.
